clips.title: The story
paras: 'Welcome to Azeroth' is an introductory quest that sends a traveler from Thunder Bluff to Orgrimmar on behalf of the Windshapers. Guided by the spiritual ties of the Earthen Ring, the emissary meets with Warchief Thrall to forge bonds of survival and alliance with the Horde.

Venturing into the sprawling expanse of Kalimdor, newcomers quickly discover that survival hinges on brotherhood. The Windshapers look beyond their isolated origins to the peoples walking below, recognizing that isolation offers no defense against the threats of Azeroth. By extending a hand to the neighboring tauren city of Thunder Bluff and looking toward the orcish bastions to the east, they seek steadfast companions to brave the wilderness together.

The journey carries envoys to the soaring towers of Thunder Bluff before directing them across the barrens to Orgrimmar, the mighty capital of the Horde. Waiting in the tranquil Valley of Wisdom is Warchief Thrall, the guiding heart of the coalition. Standing before Thrall marks the official entry of the Windshapers into the political and spiritual fabric of Kalimdor, bound by common purpose and shared respect for the elements.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Its a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.
The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Lok-tar, adventurer. I am Thrall, Warchief of the Horde.

An Earthen Ring messenger told me to expect members of the Windshapers, and here you are. I'd not have expected to see a high elf standing before me here in Orgrimmar, but the Horde will welcome you as our guest all the same.
You have my blessing to travel through Horde lands. Go with honor, Windshaper.
